thread:
Ravi Patel: Folks, travel nightmare — flight delayed. I need someone to take primary for the APAC overnight window tonight 22:00-06:00 UTC. I'm reachable until 21:50 UTC but then phone goes into airplane mode. Can @Zoe Kim pick up? Sorry for the late ask.

Oncall Bot: :robot_face: Rotation change request received. Please confirm availability and any shadowing requirements. [rotation-id: rc-1700004321]

Zoe Kim: I can cover 22:00-06:00 UTC. Heads up I have a short dentist appointment 02:15-02:45 SGT (should be reachable by text). Would like a hotshadow for that 02:00-03:00 window if possible.

Daniel Li: I can hotshadow 01:45-03:00 SGT and watch pagers during Zoe's dentist slot. I'll escalate to Priya if multiple pages.

Priya Singh: I can be secondary for the whole 22:00-06:00 UTC window. I'll take L2 escalation if needed. Add me to the rotation accept.

Ravi Patel: Plan in-thread so it's clear:
- 21:50 UTC: I run final handoff checks and leave notes on the runbook.
- 22:00 UTC: Zoe becomes primary.
- 01:45-03:00 UTC: Daniel hotshadow (covers Zoe's appointment 02:15-02:45).
- 22:00-06:00 UTC: Priya is secondary.
- Escalation flow: page -> Zoe -> Priya -> L2 oncall -> SRE CI.

Ravi Patel: Quick pre-handoff checklist (run locally and paste any failures):
```
# health checks
curl -sS https://apac-api.redwood.internal/health || echo "API unhealthy"
kubectl -n inference get pods -l region=apac -o wide
redis-cli -h apac-cache-01 INFO keyspace | grep tokens
python tools/prefix_warmer.py --region apac --models gpt-medium,gpt-large --customers onboarding,payments
```
All green from my side; warmed prefixes for top customers.

Incident Bot: :warning: Note — earlier today we had a transient P1 (ID: INC-2023-APAC-71) tied to model cache thrash. See post-incident notes: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2023-APAC-71 and runbook snippet for similar symptom handling.

Zoe Kim: Acknowledged. I'll run the prefix warm at 21:40 UTC and sync on cache state. There's a scheduled infra window in apac-south 03:00-03:20 UTC (infra-sched) that might generate probe errors; I'll tag those alerts as maintenance if they match.

Priya Singh: Confirmed secondary. I'll keep an eye on error budget and be ready to failover to dedicated if necessary. Thresholds I'll watch:
- error-rate >0.5% over 15m
- token latency P95 >800ms sustained for 10m
If triggered, I'll notify L2 and run `incident-bot create` then `traffic flip dedicated --region apac` per runbook.

Daniel Li: Added watchlist customers to my dashboard (payments, auth-service). If anything pops, I'll post minimal logs and escalate to Priya.

Ravi Patel: Calendar updated and handoff noted. Zoe, please post in this thread when you accept so pager routing updates.

Oncall Bot: :bell: Rotation change pending acceptance. Pager routing will switch after acceptance. [rc-1700004321]

Zoe Kim: Accepting rotation. Taking primary 22:00-06:00 UTC. I'll post back if I need to step out earlier.

Oncall Bot: :white_check_mark: Rotation acceptance logged: Zoe Kim (primary), Priya Singh (secondary), Daniel Li (hotshadow). Pager routing updated. [rc-1700004321: accepted]

Daniel Li: Monitoring 01:45-03:00. If I see recurrent 5xxs tied to model cache, I'll run the fallback-to-dedicated steps and ping Priya.

Priya Singh: Standby and ready. If I'm paged I'll escalate to L2 after 2 unresolved pages within 10 minutes.

Zoe Kim: Primary active. Running prefix warmer now and validating top-customer prefixes. Ping me in thread or DM for anything urgent.

Ravi Patel: Thanks team, sorry again for the late swap. I'm online until boarding. Safe shift everyone :thumbsup:
